map_system: US State Plane 1983 / NAD83 / New Mexico Eastern Zone
north_reference: printed on report header but OCR blank on page 10
input_precision: MD 1 dp (critical points 1 dp); INC/AZI 2 dp
output_precision: TVD 1 dp; N/E 1 dp; map N/E 2 dp
transcription_method: RapidOCR on 1.8x render of page 12; hold stations after 2000 thinned in CSV (full 100-ft hold remains on the PDF)
verification_notes: This is a PLAN (Design PWPO), not an as-drilled survey. Use for field-catalog and min-curvature comparison, not as a WinSERVE oracle. Vertical 0-1000 usft has N=E=0 as expected. Build 2.00°/100 ft at AZI 14.19 then hold 16.54°. Printed rounding is the tolerance floor. Lat/long omitted from CSV (available on PDF).
